name: M3_MMS310MI_Update
description: Update inventory balances for a specific warehouse, item, and location using a quick physical inventory interface. The operation works as both change and creation: it adjusts an existing balance identity if it already exists, or creates a new one when no balance is found for the given warehouse, item, location, and optional lot or container. It records the physically counted quantity and related information such as physical inventory status, priority date, catch weight, and remarks. Adjustments made here affect inventory quantities only; they do not create financial transactions or ledger postings in M3.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse where the item's inventory balance is updated.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number whose inventory balance is created or updated.

inputParameters.name: WHSL
inputParameters.description: Location within the warehouse where the inventory balance is created or updated.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number where this quick inventory update is performed.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number identifying the specific lot of the item whose inventory is updated.

inputParameters.name: CAMU
inputParameters.description: Container number identifying the handling unit or pallet for the inventory balance being updated.

inputParameters.name: REPN
inputParameters.description: Receiving number referencing the original receipt for the stock being updated.

inputParameters.name: STQI
inputParameters.description: Physical inventory quantity counted for this balance in the basic unit of measure. In MMS310MI Update it must be entered together with the physical inventory date when reporting a count.

inputParameters.name: STAG
inputParameters.description: Physical inventory status for this balance after the quick inventory update, indicating how the counted difference has been approved.

inputParameters.name: CAWI
inputParameters.description: Weight recorded for this balance, mainly for catch-weight items, and used together with the physical inventory quantity.

inputParameters.name: STDI
inputParameters.description: Physical inventory date reported for this quick inventory count. In MMS310MI Update it must be entered together with the physical inventory quantity when reporting a count.

inputParameters.name: TIHH
inputParameters.description: Hour component of the time when the physical inventory count or inventory transaction is recorded.

inputParameters.name: TIMM
inputParameters.description: Minute component of the time when the physical inventory count or inventory transaction is recorded.

inputParameters.name: TISS
inputParameters.description: Second component of the time when the physical inventory count or inventory transaction is recorded.

inputParameters.name: PRDT
inputParameters.description: Priority date used for expiration control and to determine the selection and FIFO order of this inventory balance.

inputParameters.name: TRPR
inputParameters.description: Inventory accounting price applied to this inventory transaction if a specific valuation price should be used.

inputParameters.name: BREF
inputParameters.description: First lot reference for additional identification or tracing of the lot in this inventory balance.

inputParameters.name: BRE2
inputParameters.description: Second lot reference for additional identification or selection of the lot in this inventory balance.

inputParameters.name: BREM
inputParameters.description: Remark recorded for this balance identity as part of the quick inventory update.

inputParameters.name: RSCD
inputParameters.description: Reason code describing why this quick inventory update transaction is performed.
